evidence.locator: After 72 hours, the mobile device will receive images of the individual in real time with SCP-1471-A appearing within close proximity to the subject.

effects.trigger: after more than 90 hours of exposure
constraints: more than 90 hours of exposure to the continuous images

evidence.locator: Continued exposure to SCP-1471 after this point will cause irreversible and sustained visualizations of SCP-1471-A.

constraints: elimination occurs prior to 90 hours after installation
the text identifies this as the only known treatment

evidence.locator: Currently the only known treatment to reverse SCP-1471's effect is to eliminate the individual's visual exposure to these images prior to 90 hours after installation.
